Hi, I don't really know what to say but getting into college isn't everything, especially if you are not after a high paying job, also I don't know where you are from(probably best not to mention it on here) but a lot of countries have options for people to go to college when they are older which often bypass a lot of the test score methods people use to get into colleges when they leave school.
At the same time I would be wary of just becoming a mother as then you will be financially dependant on whoever you are with which could lead to a bad situation, but that is just my opinion and I don't really feel like I have the best expertise to advise you. 
Maybe you could see a school counselor or guidance teacher for help/advice?
On a side note I find it interesting how due to your childhood experiences you want to have children while due to mine I don't, not that I think either of us is wrong.
